Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS workflow using Strep-tagging for enrichment and DDA-LFQ for quantification. Variable modifications for methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation were specified in the MaxQuant search parameters.

scope: the quantitative effects of 23 missense mutations in IFT140, which forms part of the crucial IFT-A complex of the ciliary machinery, were analyzed using affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry (AP-MS).
For interactome identification of IFT140 WT and mutants, stable HEK293 control and N-terminal Strep/FLAG-tagged IFT140 expressing cells were used.

an identical protein amount for each sample was incubated with Strep-Tactin Superflow beads (IBA) for 1 h at 4 °C while rotating at 35 rpm. The beads were washed three times with washing buffer (0.1% Nonident-P40 and 1% phosphatase inhibitor cocktails I and II (Sigma-Aldrich) in TBS), and bound proteins were eluted with Strep elution buffer (IBA).
